title: Daande Hade Henndu
intro: Limre e nder jeereende ummii ngam noddude leñol doolewol yo ngartu e goonga. Yimɓe ɓee ina nganndiraa mahdiiji mum en mawɗi e doole mum en ɗe ngalaa ɗo kaaɗi. Ammaa mawnikinaare maɓɓe wumtini ɓe, ɓe calii nanaago. Haa jooni, jukkungo bonngo heɓtii ɓe, ngo heddii tan ko e fedde seeɗa e gooŋɗinɓe.
clues: Mi neldaama to leñol doole, hoɗɓe e leyɗeele udditiiɗe, anndiraaɗe doole mum en.
Yimɓe am ngari caggal leñol goɗngol mawngol halkanoongol.
Ɓe njoginoo ko cuuɗi mawɗi, ɓe mahii cuuɗi toowɗi.
Mi noddii 6e yoo 6e ndew Alla gooto, kono 6e calii woppude sanamuuji ma66e.
Jukkungo bonngo heɓtii ɓe, ɓe ngoppidi tan ko gooŋɗinɓe e am.
Ko miin woni nelaaɗo e leñol doole ganndiraangol Aad.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Henndu mawndu halki yimɓe am, mi hisnaama
Leñol am yani e yerɓo leydi, ina woya
Leñol am ina mberloo kaaƴe gila e asamaan
Leñol am werlaa e yiite ɓuuɓɗo
outcome.answer: Henndu mawndu halki yimɓe am, mi hisnaama

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
